program: Wingless raw-input to invariant representation to zero-shot reasoning chain
question: Can a completely unseen third raw surface family acquire only a context-derived representation and then use transition knowledge learned from two other surface families without any task-transition examples of its own?
hypothesis: A raw bridge learner over three surface families will recover twenty-seven recurrent surface motifs and induce exactly nine three-member contextual alias classes. A class-transition learner trained only on task records from families 0 and 1 will then achieve at least 0.95 semantic accuracy on all eighty family-2 single-step tasks, while an exact-surface learner will have all eighty family-2 transition keys missing and at most 0.25 semantic accuracy. A frozen family-2 shuffled-context control using value rotation +3 mod 4 and operation rotation +1 mod 5 will remain at or below 0.25.

portfolio_context.allocation: 75% chain / 25% substrate falsification over the current prospective block
portfolio_context.reason: test whether learned abstraction transfers task competence to a new surface family without task-specific retraining

prior_evidence.observation: Context signatures induced nine correct two-member alias classes and restored cross-family accuracy to 1.0; exact-surface control scored 0.03125 with all 160 keys missing and shuffled-context control scored 0.15.

scope_statement: This is a bounded zero-shot surface-transfer test. Passing would show task competence can transfer through a learned raw contextual representation to a new alias family; it would not establish open-domain language transfer.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, or live-interface authority

surface_families.family0: four value motifs and five operation motifs from the prior alias lineage
surface_families.family1: four independent value motifs and five independent operation motifs from the prior alias lineage

representation_bridge.selection: top twenty-seven raw four-byte windows by occurrence count descending, then lexicographic raw key
representation_bridge.context_key: two raw bytes immediately before plus two immediately after the selected surface motif
representation_bridge.induction: surface motifs with byte-identical signatures share one class; classes ordered by signature bytes only

task_training.coverage: all five operations x all sixteen ordered value pairs x twenty repeats independently within each trained family

class_transition_learner.state: induced operation class plus ordered induced value-class pair -> observed induced output-class pair counts
class_transition_learner.prediction: argmax learned output-class pair for the class transition key; ties choose lexicographically lowest pair

controls.exact_surface: surface operation motif plus ordered surface value-motif pair -> surface output-pair counts trained on families 0 and 1 only

shuffled_family2_bridge.purpose: test whether zero-shot transfer depends on correct contextual class assignment

evaluation.records: all five operations x all sixteen ordered value pairs
evaluation.semantic_scoring: evaluator-only after prediction; class learner is scored against the induced class of the correct family-2 output aliases and exact-surface control outputs are mapped to semantic values only after prediction

validity_criteria: Exact parent, North Star, and prior qualified contextual-alias evidence identities match.
Family 2 has no task-transition training record and appears only in the raw representation bridge before evaluation.
Exactly twenty-seven raw surface motifs are selected from bridge bytes without evaluator motif seeding.
Context clustering receives no family label, semantic label, alias triplet, or task target.
Normal induced classes arise only from equality of complete raw context-count signatures.
Class-transition training receives only families 0 and 1 and never uses family-2 evaluation records.
Exact-surface control receives no bridge-induced alias mapping.
Shuffled control changes only family-2 context assignment by exactly value +3 mod 4 and operation +1 mod 5.
Semantic mappings are evaluator-only after prediction.
All metrics are finite and full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, external model, network call, capacity growth, threshold change, or adaptive evaluation occurs.

classification_rules.supported: All validity criteria and all twenty-two frozen thresholds pass; a context-only unseen surface family inherits the trained transition capability while exact-surface and shuffled-context controls fail.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and unseen-family accuracy materially exceeds both controls, but at least one representation recovery or 0.95 transfer threshold fails.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but the unseen family does not materially outperform the exact-surface control.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents the frozen bridge, training, or eighty-case evaluation.
classification_rules.invalid: Any family-2 task leakage, bridge leakage, evaluator-boundary violation, deterministic-state, capacity, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before scientific execution on parent, North Star, build, frozen-package, or family-2 isolation drift.
After output begins, complete all eighty family-2 evaluations and both controls unless infrastructure prevents it.
Do not add family-2 task examples, alias dictionaries, alter bridge contexts, increase capacity, change metrics, or weaken thresholds after observing output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No surface family, bridge context, representation rule, clustering, transition learner, control, metric, threshold, or interpretation may change after any primary output is observed under this experiment identifier.
